source.quantityConvention: Observer-centered IAU76/80 ecliptic-of-date apparent longitude and latitude, including light-time, solar gravitational deflection, and stellar aberration; airless/geocentric.
source.timeConvention: Horizons output time is UTC for this post-1962 date. LIFE supplies UTC-derived Julian Day as a UT1 approximation without DUT1 correction.

comparison.engineMode: Swiss Ephemeris, geocentric apparent tropical ecliptic longitude/latitude, default flags plus speed; local bundled ephemeris assets; UTC treated as UT1 approximation
comparison.toleranceRationale: Allows for printed reference rounding and small time-scale/model/frame realization differences while remaining substantially finer than chart-display precision.
comparison.independenceNote: This additional independent JPL Horizons/DE441 snapshot covers three bodies at a second epoch, 24 years after the existing 2000 fixture. It does not establish broad historical accuracy, time-scale correctness, or independent accuracy of every body or calculation.
